assumptions.camera_height_m: 1.40 m: mean of two independent estimates on the reference frame. (a) Forklift rear-wheel track 0.98 m (HELI 3.5 t class spec) spans 225 px at contact row y=821, 307 px below the horizon -> h = 0.98*307/225 = 1.34 m. (b) Worker standing at feet row y=775, head y=470, assumed 1.70-1.75 m tall -> h = 1.46-1.50 m. Uncertainty about +/-8%, which scales every distance.
assumptions.focal_length_px: 3500 px (~31 deg horizontal FOV): from the forklift's ~1.7 m wheelbase between rear (y=821) and front (y=792) wheel contact rows. The front contact row is only +/-5 px certain, so the plausible range is ~3000-4400 px. Focal length only scales distances along the aisle (depth); cross-aisle distances don't depend on it.
assumptions.roll: Assumed zero (ceiling beams and window sills run horizontal in the frame).
